svg.title: At comparison index i, the station construction supplies these rooted estimates for every pair of basis labels through degree i, with c = εi →0, uniformly over its fixed position window. The Gaussian readings mj, z are the singleton and pair coefficients of the Gaussian moment profile. In particular m0m1 + z is its full two-point coefficient, by the defining cumulant identity. Write Qi(x) for the rounded position tuple and riQi(x) for the actual physical tuple. If x is generic and has a neighborhood in the comparison window, then Qi(x) →x, so it is eventually generic and stays in that window. Smoothness of the free hierarchy implies convergence, and hence boundedness, of its two singleton readings at Qi(x). Equation (IG3) yields convergence of the interacting two-point reading to the free two-point reading at x.
